s1.ptxt: Place gear shift lever in “Neutral”, apply parking brake and block drive wheels.
Warm up engine to normal operating temperature.
Stop engine and turn off all electric switches.
With ignition “OFF”, connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC (1).
Check “Boost Pressure” under “Data List” mode on scan tool under the following conditions.

item.ptxt: Accelerator pedal: Depress fully for 5 seconds and release

spec.title: Boost pressure specification
spec.ptxt: 20 to 55 kPa (0.2 to 0.6 kgf/cm2, 2.90 to 7.97 psi, 0.20 to 0.55 bar)

s1.ptxt: If boost pressure is out of specified range, the following causes are suspected.
After completing the check, set ignition “OFF” and disconnect SUZUKI scan tool from DLC.
